author: Megaprojects
description:
The Bradley Fighting Vehicle nearly never existed, surviving multiple cancellations before becoming America's most versatile armoured combat vehicle. From Gulf War tank-killing to Ukraine's frontlines against Russian T-90s, this Swiss army knife of warfare outlasted every replacement attempt. Now, after four decades and billions spent, the XM30 replacement finally approaches.
